source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Numbers 9–10. All 59 exact original records are hashed, including eight source annotations across 9:3, 9:10, 9:21, 10:9, 10:25, 10:34 and 10:36. Later book numbering differences require separate mapping.

key_decisions.decision: Keep one trumpet distinct from two, retain the thousands designation as a social/military grouping and clarify that the leaders are summoned.
Keep the specific teruah signal and east-side camps; do not invent the signal’s pitch, length or number of notes.
Preserve second/south and the repeated departure signal; do not add west/north signals absent from the pinned Hebrew.
Retain the deliberate distinction between an assembly blast and teruah; avoid assigning an unattested modern musical pattern.
Keep war in their land, oppressive adversary, trumpet signal, remembered-before-God language and rescue; do not convert this into a general endorsement of war.
Retain the three occasions, two offering categories and memorial before God, linked to remembered in verse 9; beginnings of months preserves the calendar expression without imposing a modern date.
Keep Gad’s unit and Deuel as written here and in 7:42, without harmonizing Reuel in 2:14.

Render carrying the sanctuary as its holy things in the context of chapters 4 and 7; distinguish the Kohathites’ arrival from the unnamed plural who set up the tent, using passive rather than a false same-subject reading.
Render the gathering-up role as rear guard in the march context; retain all camps, division structure, leader and exact source punctuation annotation.
Retain Hobab/Reuel/Midian and use a broader marriage-kin term with father-in-law and attachment uncertainties noted; preserve quoted promise and repeated good language leading to verse 32.
Preserve the plea, wilderness-camping knowledge and eyes image rather than replacing it with a generic guide alone.
Retain both three-day references and the ark’s forward position and searching purpose; do not turn journey duration into a three-day gap or harmonize the earlier order of holy things.
Keep habitual invocation, divine enemies and haters, and the direct appeal; preserve poetic parallelism and its force inside the verse paragraph.

Retain the paired resting invocation, return and both large-number terms without reducing them to an exact census total; to is supplied for the compressed relation, noted alongside source boundary marks.
